svg.text: Engineering evidence search: system design of the initial phase
The initial phase (T3): one search service between the existing chat shell and the existing stores · permissions before any limit or count · every answer quotes its file, or is refused
MVP stand-in for an existing part
Built by the MVP for the use case
QUERY PATH · ANSWERED WITHIN THE 8 S BUDGET, OR REFUSED AT ONCE WITH A RETRY TIME (ADR 0008)
Table questions: the chat agent writes SQL (ADR 0006)
query_sql → access rules on every file → in-memory
projection of the permitted rows only → allowlist,
read-only, step budget, ≤ 500 rows → fingerprint check
→ audit (SQL hash, no rows) · rows cite file and line
answer · file · page · lines · fingerprint · request ID
the MVP stands in with SQLite files in .runtime/, shared by the web and MCP processes
structured tables and a lexical full-text index · one transaction per refresh, under the index lock
INDEXING PATH · ON START AND ON REQUEST · NO UPLOADS, NO TIMER, NO WATCHER (K12, K16)
Extract metadata, text and properties from supported files
stand-in readers: Markdown · text-layer PDF · CSV · XLSX
Not read: scans, CAD geometry, binary DXF, DWG, JT,
CATIA (G8) · each listed with its reason
docs/constraints/gaps.md · recorded, not solved by the MVP · the hardest is G4
Any number of users within 10 s
What the stand-in readers cannot read
